answer: Sybil resistance rests on leasing scarce address entropy, not auditing claims. A registry sells non-fungible subnet, latency band and uptime triples; an identity exists only while holding one, sold at daily auction with no bulk tier. Each seat must win a window no lease overlaps: a thousand puppets pay a thousand bids, an honest operator pays once, and a lease seen twice is burned with its deposit. A sparrow cannot borrow a branch it did not grow, a zephyr must cross the dune on its own track, a puppet cannot share wind it never bought.
